metadata.description: Validation test for GPS Rescue without a home (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T13c): armed with 14 satellites, disarmed, then re-armed at 1.5 s with 7 (no home; RESCUE OFF for 3 s). Alt Hold from 4 s; the rescue switch at 6 s fails with NO_HOME_POINT and does nothing, holding the last autopilot throttle, so the quad sinks and disarms on impact.
